summary.name: FireHydrant
summary.one_liner: FireHydrant is an incident management platform that combines alerting, on-call scheduling, automated runbooks, AI-assisted incident workflows, status pages, and post-incident retrospectives.
use_cases: managing production incidents from Slack or Teams
scheduling on-call rotations and alerting engineers
writing and automating incident response runbooks
running post-incident retrospectives and tracking action items
sending status page updates to stakeholders
summary.what_it_does: The page describes FireHydrant as an all-in-one incident management platform covering on-call, alerting, automated runbooks, and a service catalog for ownership and dependencies. It supports managing incidents in Slack or Teams, with AI-generated incident summaries, status page updates, and live transcriptions of Zoom and Google Meet calls. Post-incident features include AI-enhanced retrospectives, automatic capture and assignment of follow-up action items, and analytics for tracking MTTx and patterns. It also lists an API with 350+ endpoints, Terraform support, and SDKs for extensibility.
notable: AI-enhanced retrospectives and automatic follow-up action items
Live Zoom and Google Meet transcriptions documented automatically
350+ API endpoints, Terraform support, and SDKs
Enterprise security features: SOC 2, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, SCIM
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it only says it is priced to fit any team
Page is mostly marketing claims; the 90% faster and 91% MTTM figures are customer-reported or promotional and not independently verified
